requirements.title: ISO_Fortran_binding.h contains the specified structures, typedefs, macros, and prototypes
requirements.source: S18.5.1 p1 required contents; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF531.
requirements.definition: ISO_Fortran_binding.h shall contain the C structure definitions, typedef declarations, macro definitions, and function prototypes specified in 18.5.2 through 18.5.5.

pending.iso-fortran-binding-required-structures: Compile a C translation unit that includes ISO_Fortran_binding.h and declares CFI_dim_t, CFI_cdesc_t *, and CFI_CDESC_T(0) objects; mutate one required structure type name to a local undeclared spelling.
pending.iso-fortran-binding-required-typedefs: In the same C translation unit, assign sentinel values through CFI_index_t, CFI_rank_t, CFI_type_t, and CFI_attribute_t variables and pass their addresses to helpers with matching parameter types; mutate one helper parameter to int * only for a typedef-specific mismatch.
pending.iso-fortran-binding-required-macros: Use preprocessing conditional directives or _Static_assert expressions naming CFI_VERSION, CFI_MAX_RANK, every Table 18.3 attribute macro, every Table 18.4 type macro, and every Table 18.5 error macro; mutate by deleting one macro reference through a generated source variant.
pending.iso-fortran-binding-required-function-pr: After 18.5.5 is registered, compile a C unit taking addresses of CFI_address, CFI_allocate, CFI_deallocate, CFI_establish, CFI_is_contiguous, CFI_section, CFI_select_part, and CFI_setpointer with standard prototype-compatible function pointers; mutate one pointer signature.

requirements.title: ISO_Fortran_binding.h declarations let C functions interpret descriptors for non-interoperable dummies
requirements.source: S18.5.1 p1 C descriptor use; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF531.
requirements.definition: The definitions and declarations in ISO_Fortran_binding.h can be used by a C function to interpret and manipulate a C descriptor and to specify a C prototype interoperating with a Fortran interface that has a non-interoperable dummy variable.

pending.c-function-interprets-c-descriptor: Use a Fortran procedure with an assumed-shape integer dummy and a C companion taking CFI_cdesc_t *; initialize actual values [11, 13, 17], have C read elem_len, rank, type, dim extent, and base_addr, then mutate the C formal to void * to lose descriptor interpretation.
pending.c-prototype-for-noninteroperable-dummy: Declare the Fortran BIND(C) interface for a noninteroperable assumed-shape dummy and the matching C prototype with CFI_cdesc_t *; the positive control links and checks descriptor rank, while the mutation changes the C formal to int *.

requirements.title: ISO_Fortran_binding.h inclusion is order-independent and idempotent apart from line numbers
requirements.source: S18.5.1 p2; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF531.
requirements.definition: ISO_Fortran_binding.h may be included in any order relative to standard C headers and may be included more than once in a scope with no effect different from a single inclusion other than line numbers.

pending.include-before-standard-c-headers: Compile a C unit including ISO_Fortran_binding.h before <stddef.h>, <stdint.h>, <stdbool.h>, and <complex.h>, then use size_t, int32_t, bool, _Complex, CFI_cdesc_t, and CFI_VERSION in one static assertion block; mutation reverses a required macro expectation.
pending.include-after-standard-c-headers: Compile a sibling C unit including the same standard C headers before ISO_Fortran_binding.h and assert the same CFI_MAX_RANK lower bound and attribute-code distinctness; mutation removes the second include.
pending.include-multiple-times-idempotent: Compile a C unit including ISO_Fortran_binding.h twice in one scope and once through a helper header, then declare CFI_CDESC_T(1) storage and compare CFI_VERSION to itself; mutation injects a local conflicting CFI_VERSION macro between includes.

requirements.title: C sources including ISO_Fortran_binding.h shall not use reserved CFI names or macro-redefine header structures
requirements.source: S18.5.1 p3 restrictions; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF531.
requirements.definition: A C source file that includes ISO_Fortran_binding.h shall not use CFI_-prefixed names not defined in the header and shall not define the header-defined structure names as macro names.

pending.no-undefined-cfi-prefixed-user-names: Positive source control uses only header-defined CFI_* identifiers and a user helper named local_descriptor_probe; source-control mutations introduce CFI_local_probe as a user function without claiming a required diagnostic.
pending.no-macro-redefinition-of-header-structur: Positive source control defines an unrelated macro LOCAL_CDESC_ALIAS before the include; source-control mutations define CFI_cdesc_t or CFI_dim_t as a macro name before the include without claiming a required diagnostic.

requirements.title: ISO_Fortran_binding.h exposes only CFI, underscore, member, or standard-header names
requirements.source: S18.5.1 p3 header namespace; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF531.
requirements.definition: All names other than structure member names defined in ISO_Fortran_binding.h begin with CFI_ or an underscore character, or are names defined by a standard C header that ISO_Fortran_binding.h includes.
